metadata.title: Does Multi-Token Attention Actually Help Clinical Q&A?
metadata.note: STEM/AI topic-of-interest video, based on the author's own published research: 'Testing Multi-Token Attention in Clinical Question Answering' (IJCAI 2025) — benchmarked Multi-Token Attention against standard transformer models on 2,000 clinical QA pairs, finding standard architectures outperformed MTA by up to 7.7 points. Built using the same proven pattern set as the SurveyMind video: folderLabel set explicitly on ClaudeComposerAsk beats (@HumanitariansAI), OutroCTA used instead of ClaudeTitleOutro (which is hardcoded to @NikBearBrown and cannot be reskinned), no stale sparse_by_design QC flags except the legitimate BrutalistHesitantWriter typing-beat exemption.
